convergence.reason: The 200000-step run stopped at its cap with -6.69 dB residual energy instead of reaching the requested -15.23 dB criterion.

release_decision.first_article_fabrication_recommendation: proceed after PCBWay stackup and via confirmations
release_decision.rationale: The standalone antenna and exact one-port control pass, and every full-grid checkpoint passes the coupling limit. The full-grid transient is not converged, so its S11 and precise coupling values are screening evidence rather than RF qualification.
required_before_repeat_or_volume_build: VNA measurement of the antenna and RF coupon across 24.150-24.250 GHz
multiport measurement or channel-isolation test demonstrating at least 20 dB isolation
comparison of measured results with the simulation envelope
